snippet.title: The Last Mothership - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4088300/The_Last_Mothership

The Last Mothership is a short incremental game about harvesting planets to feed your mothership. Mine, manage resources, grow your fleet, and unlock upgrades to evolve your species. You are the devourer of worlds.
